newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia government adopts draft budget for H1 97.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia government adopts draft budget for H1 97.

text.p: The Slovenian government said on Thursday it had adopted a draft budget for the first half of 1997, setting government spending at 326.4 billion tolars ($2.3 billion) and income at 327.6 billion tolars.
"We introduced the draft budget because parliament is unlikely to pass next year's budget before June," Andrej Engelman, secretary at the Ministry of Finance, told a news conference.
He said 1997 spending should not exceed 720 billion tolars, but gave no further details. In 1996, Slovenia budgeted to spend 594.2 billion tolars.
